# Amthromax

> Amthromax is an AI software and technology company building enterprise AI platforms, intelligent agents, intelligent automation, developer infrastructure, APIs, and next-generation software systems.

Amthromax Inc. designs and operates the software layer that lets organisations run
autonomous and semi-autonomous AI systems in production: an orchestration platform,
agent runtimes, workflow automation, and the developer tooling, SDKs and APIs that sit
around them. This site covers the products themselves, the research and safety work that
informs them, and the documentation engineers need to build on top.

- Canonical origin: https://amthromax.com
- Contact: contact@amthromax.com
- Full URL inventory: https://amthromax.com/sitemap.xml
- Crawler policy: https://amthromax.com/robots.txt

## Products

- [Products index](https://amthromax.com/products): All Amthromax product lines in one place.
- [AI Platform](https://amthromax.com/products/ai-platform): Core enterprise AI platform — models, routing, evaluation, and governance.
- [AI Agents](https://amthromax.com/products/ai-agents): Agent runtime for planning, tool use, and long-running autonomous tasks.
- [Automation](https://amthromax.com/products/automation): Intelligent workflow automation across systems of record.
- [Developer Platform](https://amthromax.com/products/developer-platform): APIs, SDKs, and infrastructure for building on Amthromax.
- [Enterprise AI](https://amthromax.com/products/enterprise-ai): Deployment, security, and scale characteristics for large organisations.
- [Services](https://amthromax.com/services): Implementation, integration, and managed engagements.

## Flagship systems

- [Helleious](https://amthromax.com/helleious): The Amthromax AI operating system — the substrate the rest of the stack runs on.
- [Helleious safety and governance](https://amthromax.com/helleious-safety): Safety architecture, guardrails, and the governance model for Helleious.
- [CodeHoomer](https://amthromax.com/codehoomer): AI system for software engineering workflows.
- [OrarQlow](https://amthromax.com/orarqlow): AI system for orchestrated, high-throughput operational flows.
